notes:
- New: the inspector is now laid out as simple steps (body, how it is pulled, band position, bake); optional and advanced settings are folded away
- New: Drop speed (Advanced) - how fast a let-go stocking falls to the floor
- Changed: the setup name is assigned automatically and no longer needs to be typed (existing setups keep their name)
- Changed: a stocking released in the air now flutters down from where you let go, and lands flat instead of spinning or standing on its edge
- Fixed: skin poking through the back of the leg while the stocking is being pulled off
- Faster: baking is quicker (results unchanged)
- Note: stockings re-bake automatically the next time you press Play
